company.shortDescription: Toku create bespoke cloud communications and customer engagement solutions to reimagine customer experiences for enterprises.
company.description: Toku develops software for customer communication and engagement. The company provides tools that support messaging, voice calls, and digital interactions. It uses artificial intelligence to help automate customer conversations. It supports chat, voice, and messaging applications for business use. The system routes conversations and processes customer requests.
